title: Nordle post performance numbers
description: How the posts of one brand actually performed: the numbers the owner exports from the platform (or types in), one entry per post, platform and window. Lives at <project>/metrics.json. Nothing here is estimated: an entry is a copy of what a platform showed on the day it was captured.

post.description: The calendar item id this is about.

publishedAt.description: When the platform says it went out (ISO 8601, or a date). Optional: the calendar item's date is used otherwise.

capturedAt.description: The day (or time) the numbers were read off the platform.

window.description: How long after publishing these numbers cover. Numbers from different windows are never mixed.

views.description: Views (Instagram's current headline number for reels, carousels and photos).

follows.description: New followers that came from this post.

avgWatchSec.description: Average watch time per view, in seconds.

completionRate.description: Share of views that reached the end, 0 to 1 (45 percent is 0.45).

swipes.description: Carousels: swipes, when the platform gives them.

source.description: csv = an export the owner imported; manual = typed in; buffer, meta = read from the platform's own interface by a connector.

by.description: Who entered it (so a number Claude typed from something the owner said can be told apart).
